items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: I think his wife told us that too, Mrs. Stella Oliver.

ctx.x: That's why he had a number that he used to play with brass band. Yeah. He tried 16th and written on March. Uh-huh.

This past the street is right on the old mountain. Somebody, uh, Bunk told me it was second and magazine, they used to call it, where he was a butler. I think his wife told us that too, Mrs. Stella Oliver. Yeah. What do you want to see? Magazine Street, I believe, I'm not sure, you know.

He used to come on a Saturday night. Uh-huh. In that time, they had the Eagle band. Yeah. He used to come on Saturday night. Yeah. And treat the band. I told y'all, Frank, I didn't play a 16-Ribbon March. Uh-huh. And he got out on his feet. I wondered when you first played with Joe then, you wouldn't play the dance the first
